B4_B5_joint_review: compact proof does not serialize expanded denominator 2**P; every optional rational export would still require reduced denominator <10**4096; compatibility approval includes finite-policy.json
attempt_digest_rule: H0=SHA256(ASCII LAB_C1B1_ATTEMPTS_V1 + NUL); H_next=SHA256(previous raw digest32 + canonical {t,N,P,producer,rechecker,reason}); bounded tuple uses pre-str integer guards; fixed status/reason enums; no histories serialized; digest is diagnostic binding, not independent proof
encoding: ASCII JSON, keys lexical sorted, compact separators, ensure_ascii escapes, exactly one terminal LF; SHA-256 over exact bytes
failure_attempt_count_bound: attempt_count is always null in failure records; bounded rolling attempt_digest is retained; no integer-to-string conversion of an unbounded failure count
limit_basis: 4096 digits and 1048576 bytes retain audited Claim V1 envelope; bounded new failure envelope is structural publication policy, not computation budget
parameter_projection: 9 fixed rate entries, mode FULL only; sqrt_bits=N, work_bits=P_R significant precision; order=n_R from finite policy; producer local range-reduced order is not reused as V2 order
parser_order: byte/structure/key/array/depth and decimal syntax/digit bounds before int; host lower int-string conversion limit => bounded HOST_SERIALIZATION_LIMIT at PARSE with resource_kind HOST_DECIMAL; exact reduction and closed schema/spec checks; no global setter and no raw ValueError leak
proof_representation: compact reconstruction certificate: original state and spec references, common method parameters and raw claims; producer intervals and attempt transcripts are NOT proof inputs
publication: 3 lanes validated and accepted together; no partial raw/certificate/state; resolved calculation can fail publication
resource_failure_record: closed fixed fields only: schema,status,phase,reason,spec_sha256,state_sha256,occurrence_sha256,budget_sha256,attempt_count,attempt_digest; hashes nullable if unknown; no raw, large integer, exception text or payload
resource_kind_rule: required Failure field; closed enum for observed cap/deadline, null for nonresource failure; actual interruption category is preserved; elapsed timing is not a mathematical authority
scope_of_limits: runtime Input/Certificate/Artifact/Failure only; static approved source/constants/specification bundles have separate fixed schemas (constants has exactly 91 records) and pinned bytes; they cannot be embedded or overridden on request wire

types.absence: JSON null only where explicitly permitted
types.enum: closed ASCII token listed by schema
types.hash: lowercase hex SHA-256 string of exactly 64 characters
types.integer: JSON string: 0 or -?[1-9][0-9]*; no +, -0 or leading zeros

unresolved_items: independent closure review and IMPLEMENTATION MAY START decision
writer_order: exact canonical reduction within computation/allocation caps
abs(n)<10**4096 and 0<d<10**4096 by integer comparison BEFORE str
decimal conversion, catch host lower digit-limit failure without global setter
zero_axis: EXACT_ZERO_AXIS: prove q_raw[k]=0 after complete schema/spec/domain validation; claim raw=0; legacy V2 not called on this axis
